latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video Honor.

- Instantly create tribute videos from uploaded images with AI-powered motion effects and music.
- Simple, no-edit UI: upload, give instructions, and receive a 1080p MP4 ready to share.
- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC images up to 200MB; exports in multiple formats.
- Automatically manages cloud session setup and free token generation.
- Built-in workflows for uploading, editing, exporting, and credit management.
- Designed for speed and ease of use—no video editing experience required.
